name: Kabelwerk Rhönsberg GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 7 of 24 invoices paid >3 days late, max 5 days. Avg 1.6 days late; fine.

notes: 2026 renewal on top of index: asked 8.6%, settled 6.0% (EV-2026-70560-350040).
Index steps: Q2-26 305.70, Q3-26 316.35 (EV-2026-70560-350040-Q3), all formula-correct.

situation: Cable maker (EUR 98 m) on a copper index clause (CU-NOTATION, share 0.55, no deadband, quarterly); frame ctr:4600070560 ends 2026-12-31 and it asks our volumes for renewal (P14). The clause already lifted the price 279.40 -> 316.35 per 100 m in 2026 (+13.2%) and the formula would give ~328.77 from Oct 2026. Yet it bought copper forward to March 2027 and offers 316.35 fixed, valid 90 days. Its real cost is hedged while our index price chases the market: the clause is a windfall for them.

pressures.evidence: Copper hedged to March 2027; quote fixed accordingly.

what_it_values: margin protection after March 2027 (wants an index then)

likely_tradeables.get: no index (fixed EUR 316.35) through 2027, or share <=0.55 with deadband >=5%
likely_tradeables.why: hedged copper means fixing costs them nothing near-term; copper still rising

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Copper is hedged until March 2027, so index pass-through of CU-NOTATION (+47.7% yoy) does not reflect your cost.
arguments_that_should_land.why: their own words; turns the index against them

arguments_to_avoid.why: Q4 formula already ~328.77 and rising; fixed 316.35 is cheaper
